meta.name: Criss Cross (1949) Burt Lancaster, Yvonne De Carlo, Dan Duryea
meta.description: Criss Cross is a 1949 American crime film noir directed by Robert Siodmak starring Burt Lancaster, Yvonne De Carlo and Dan Duryea, from Don Tracy's novel of the same name. This film was shot partly on location in the Bunker Hill section of Los Angeles.
